Pier L
arxiv-2401-00200.creator: Matteo Cordioli 2 , Laura Delfino 1 , Alessia Romani 1 , Elisa Mortini 1 , Pier Luca Lanzi 2
arxiv-2401-00200.description: Abstract We present a framework to assist therapists and children with autism spectrum disorder in their Applied Behavioral Analysis (ABA) therapy. The framework was designed in collaboration with Spazio Autismo, an autism center in Mantova, Italy. The framework is a first step toward transitioning from the current paper-based to fully digital-supported therapy.

arxiv-2510-26603.title: Agentic AI Home Energy Management System: A Large Language Model Framework for Residential Load Scheduling
arxiv-2510-26603.creator: Reda El Makroum, Sebastian Zwickl-Bernhard, Lukas Kranzl
arxiv-2510-26603.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Reda El Makroum, Sebastian Zwickl-Bernhard, Lukas Kranzl. Abstract The sustainable transformation of the electricity sector requires substantial increases in residential demand response capacity. Yet, Home Energy Management Systems (HEMS) adoption remains limited by user interaction barriers that require translating everyday preferences into technical parameters.

arxiv-2512-04397.title: Performance Evaluation of Transfer Learning Based Medical Image Classification Techniques for Disease Detection
arxiv-2512-04397.creator: Zeeshan Ahmad, Shudi Bao, Meng Chen
arxiv-2512-04397.description: Abstract Medical image classification plays an increasingly vital role in identifying various diseases by classifying medical images, such as X-rays, MRIs and CT scans, into different categories based on their features. In recent years, deep learning techniques have attracted significant attention in medical image classification. However, it is usually infeasible to train an entire large deep learning model from scratch.

arxiv-2602-09145.title: Estimating causal effects of functional treatments with modified functional treatment policies
arxiv-2602-09145.creator: Ziren Jiang, Erjia Cui, Jared D. Huling
arxiv-2602-09145.description: Abstract Functional data are increasingly prevalent in biomedical research. While functional data analysis has been established for decades, causal inference with functional treatments remains largely unexplored. Existing methods typically focus on estimating the causal average dose–response functional (ADRF), which requires strong positivity assumptions and offers limited interpretability.

pmc-10738687.title: A BAYESIAN NETWORK-BASED APPROACH FOR MULTI-OMICS INTEGRATION TO REVEAL UNDERLYING MECHANISMS OF HEALTHY AGING
pmc-10738687.creator: Anastasia Leshchyk, Stefano Monti, Paola Sebastiani
pmc-10738687.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Previous research on long-lived individuals showed that centenarians significantly delay the onset of the disability and aging-related diseases such as Alzheimer’s, dementia, and cardiovascular diseases to the very end of their lives compared to the general population. Genetic studies of centenarians and healthy agers showed that carriers of the APOE e2 allele had increased odds of reaching longevity compared to the non-e2 allele carriers.

pmc-10741225.title: Investigating Immunomodulatory Biomaterials for Preventing the Foreign Body Response
pmc-10741225.creator: Alexia Kim, Mauricio A. Downer, Charlotte E. Berry, Caleb Valencia, Alex Z. Fazilat, Michelle Griffin
pmc-10741225.description: Implantable biomaterials represent the forefront of regenerative medicine, providing platforms and vessels for delivering a creative range of therapeutic benefits in diverse disease contexts. However, the chronic damage resulting from implant rejection tends to outweigh the intended healing benefits, presenting a considerable challenge when implementing treatment-based biomaterials.

pmc-11477916.title: New Polymer Biocomposites Based on Biopoly(Ethylene Terephthalate) and Waste Mollusc Shells
pmc-11477916.creator: Stanisław Kuciel, Karina Rusin-Żurek, Maria Kurańska, Patricia Krawczak
pmc-11477916.description: Currently, scientific studies have are focusing on environmentally friendly solutions, such as the effective use of waste in new green polymeric materials according to circular economy. Waste valorization is the main driving force for upcoming academic research. In this study, the impact of mussel particle size on reinforced biopoly(terphtalate ethylene) (bPET) is investigated. The waste filler was modified using NaOH.

pmc-13082381.title: Stimulus duration modulates awareness-dependent brain activation in the fusiform gyrus independently of task-relevance
pmc-13082381.creator: Antje Peters, Annika Hense, Maximilian Bruchmann, Torge Dellert, Insa Schlossmacher, Robert Moeck, Thomas Straube
pmc-13082381.description: Conscious perception in daily life encompasses continuous experience and persistent percepts of visual inputs. However, the temporal dimension of consciousness, specifically neural mechanisms maintaining sustained conscious percepts over time, remains comparatively understudied. Many studies feature either brief stimulus durations or prolonged supraliminal stimuli without inducing an unconscious comparison condition.

pmc-13383426.title: Pharmacological manipulation of Sema4D by salvianolic acid A mitigates diabetic retinopathy via inhibiting PlexinB1/RhoA/ROCK/pMLC2 signaling cascade involved in endothelial dysfunction
pmc-13383426.creator: Weiwei Zheng, Ling Ning, Peiliang Shen, Jing Ma, Chang Yu, Ruiqin Jia, Liwenyu Chen, Wei Zou, Yuhua Xu, Yanhong Pan, Zhonghong Wei, Qiuhong Shen, Chongjin Zhong, Aiyun Wang, Wenxing Chen, Juan Chen, Suyun Yu, Jia Li, Yin Lu, Yang Zhao
pmc-13383426.description: BackgroundDiabetic retinopathy (DR) is a leading cause of blindness. While anti-vascular endothelial growth factor (VEGF) therapy is effective, its utility is limited by variable patient response and the need for frequent injections. Therefore, identifying new therapeutic targets for DR is imperative.

pmc-13578224.title: Gigavoxel-scale multiple-scattering-aware lensless holotomography
pmc-13578224.creator: Mikołaj Rogalski, Julianna Winnik, Julia Dudek, Piotr Arcab, Emilia Wdowiak, Paweł Matryba, Marzena Stefaniuk, Piotr Zdańkowski, Maciej Trusiak
pmc-13578224.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Holotomography (HT) has revolutionized quantitative label-free 3D imaging, yet conventional lens-based implementations are fundamentally constrained in field-of-view (FOV) and imaging depth, limiting their utility for critical high-throughput applications in material and life sciences. Lensless HT (LHT) offers a promising alternative for large-volume examination, however existing approaches fail to accurately reconstruct highly scattering samples over extended depths, which remains a critical challenge in optical imaging field.
